acceptance.given: 评估一个 Consumer-transition omission 或 applicability exception，且候选实现尝试自行创建或使用该例外。

oracle.expected: 仅当现有授权 repository 或 ADR owner 在执行前确认并显式绑定例外时，治理判定才允许省略该 Consumer transition；否则 transition 必须执行。
forbidden: 未获执行前确认和显式绑定的例外被接受。
候选实现自行创建 Consumer-transition exception。
oracle.observable: governance_policy.py 返回的例外授权判定及其绑定 owner、确认状态和执行前绑定状态可被测试断言。

acceptance.then: Consumer transition 被执行，或具有执行前确认且显式绑定的授权例外被接受。
acceptance.when: Consumer transition omission 或 applicability exception 进入治理判定时

failure_intents.selector_intent: 运行 `py -3 -m pytest .agents/skills/quick-dev-tdd-adapter/tools/tests/test_consumer_manifest_exception_authority.py -k unbound_exception_rejected`，验证未绑定例外不能使 Consumer transition 被省略。
运行 `py -3 -m pytest .agents/skills/quick-dev-tdd-adapter/tools/tests/test_consumer_manifest_exception_authority.py -k candidate_created_exception_rejected`，验证候选实现创建的例外不会获得授权。

slice_hint.behavior_change: 治理判定要求 Consumer transition omission 具备现有授权 repository 或 ADR owner 的执行前确认与显式绑定；未满足时强制执行 transition，并拒绝候选实现自建例外。

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: 保持现有治理状态与非授权输出兼容；回滚仅移除 Consumer exception 的确认、绑定和拒绝逻辑，不改变其他授权边界。

slice_hint.state_transition: 未确认且未绑定的 omission exception -> transition executes；执行前由现有授权 owner 确认并显式绑定 -> omission 可被接受。
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: 任何被接受的 Consumer omission 都带有执行前确认、现有授权 owner 身份及显式绑定；缺任一要素或由候选实现创建时，判定失败并要求 transition 执行。

Validation succeeds while orphan nodes remain.

Run the planned Exact Cover negative selector with a one-directional relationship and require validation failure.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore prior Toolchain conformance behavior without changing Phase service state or schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unverified Exact Cover graph becomes a graph checked for bidirectional relationships and orphan absence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The planned selector reports zero orphan nodes across every required node type and fails for an orphan or one-way relationship.

acceptance.given: A frozen non-empty Consumer Manifest and the reconciled repository real-call surface, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers, are available.

oracle.expected: Every applicable Consumer completes enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable through its real call surface; rollback observes the Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category.
forbidden: A manifest entry lacks a reconciled real caller.
Configuration-only switching is accepted as rollback.
oracle.observable: Per-Consumer transition call receipts and the bidirectional Consumer Manifest/call-surface reconciliation.

acceptance.then: All applicable transitions for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry are complete.
acceptance.when: The Consumer transition selector executes against the frozen manifest.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the Consumer transition selector with one applicable real-call-surface transition omitted or unreachable.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconcile the complete non-empty Consumer Manifest bidirectionally with the repository real-call surface, then require each applicable Consumer to execute enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable through its real interface.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Consumer routes and require rollback to reproduce the bound Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen manifest with applicable transitions pending -> every applicable Consumer has real-call receipts for enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selector proves 100% transition completion for the reconciled non-empty manifest and rejects omissions, unreachable consumers, and configuration-only rollback.

acceptance.given: The required target package is missing from the repository-contained target set.

oracle.expected: The operation is rejected or blocked and no target is accepted or used.
forbidden: Inspection or package use proceeds with a missing target.
Another target is silently selected or substituted.
oracle.observable: The command result and receipt show a missing-target rejection with no accepted target identity and no target-dependent operation.

acceptance.then: The target-selection and inspection path emits a deterministic rejection and performs no target-dependent work.
acceptance.when: Invoke target selection and inspection with the required target absent.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the missing-target validator case and require a failing observation if any target is accepted or inspected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Fail closed on an absent target without selecting, substituting, or inspecting another target.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing target identity and rejection categories; add no fallback target behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: required target present -> target removed or unresolved -> deterministic rejection with no accepted target.
